description: Surface lines of the 14 meridians on the skin of data/body/skin.glb, drawn through the points of data/points.json.
method: Each segment is an ordered list of point codes. Between consecutive points the line follows the shortest path over the skin surface (Dijkstra on the subdivided skin mesh), is smoothed with re-projection onto the skin, resampled about every 4 mm, and offset 1.2 mm outward along the skin normal so that it renders above the skin. The order of points follows the body-surface course shown in standard meridian charts; internal courses are not drawn. Left and right lines are drawn separately; the crossing of the Large Intestine meridian at the philtrum is not drawn. A code in "via" is a waypoint on another meridian; "mid:A:B" is the midpoint of points A and B of the same side, projected onto the skin, used as a waypoint.

frame.origin: Z-Anatomy original origin: x = 0 is the mid-sagittal plane of the model, y = 0 is at the soles
frame.body: Z-Anatomy male body, standing, undeformed (data/body/*.glb); height of the skin 1709.5 mm

fields.lines: per side (L, R; M for GV and CV): list of segments
fields.id: segment id, unique within its meridian
fields.codes: point codes (and waypoints) the segment passes through, in order
fields.via: entries of codes that are waypoints of another meridian or midpoints (mid:A:B)
fields.knots: for each entry of codes, the index of its sample in points
fields.points: samples [x, y, z] in mm along the line
